changes: Fixed review request lists the exact required brand asset element ids (empty set stated explicitly), separate from product scene/label checks
Independent comparison input is a whitelisted review projection; author text checks stay out of the reviewer input
Series plans run all member direction checks up front and accept one user confirmation for the whole set; each member is locked to the same real message
Native review workflow assigns ids, paths and timestamps and reports field, value and legal source on errors
Immutable series plan no longer carries progress; progress lives in run-status via a whitelisted command
Recommendations show clarity, purpose fit, novelty and production risk side by side and keep user-proposed origins
Small user delivery package (finished artwork plus essentials) alongside the full audit archive; shared frozen rollout evidence stored once
Stage timing and failure-recovery records (record only)
Single CURRENT pointer kept consistent with the run README and receipts
legacy_regressions: Historical schema definitions preserved; 64 suites (3639 runs) and 270-stage pipeline pass
limits: Upgrading mid-run requires registering the upgrade chain; checks are re-run under the new version before delivery
Automatic checks are model judgments, not human approval
promotion_basis: Verified candidate runtime with documented distribution cleanup; publication only after explicit user authorization.
